name: Texas retainage on public works contracts
standard: Texas Government Code Chapter 2252, Subchapter B
edition: As amended by Acts 2021, 87th Legislature, H.B. 692, effective 15 June 2021
description: Enables the checks on retention held by a governmental entity. One contract-value threshold governs: below a 5 million dollar contract price the entity may not withhold more than 10 percent, and at or above it the cap falls to 5 percent, with no line of a schedule of values carrying a higher rate than the contract cap. Work related to a dam stays at 10 percent whatever the price. Retainage exceeding 5 percent of the periodic payments must be deposited in an interest-bearing account. The subchapter does not reach a contract whose total price estimate at execution is under 400 thousand dollars, contracts of the state transportation department, or contracts executed before 31 August 1981, so the rules check that a project below the floor is not silently assumed to be capped.
thresholds_referenced: Contract price 5,000,000 US dollars switches the cap from 10 to 5 percent; the subchapter floor is 400,000 US dollars
